title: Blue Queen Suit Walk to Broadway, Parking + Pool
description:
Experience Nashville @ The Royal Luxe Suite. This barn style 1 bedroom & 1 bathroom w/ a modern touch in the heart of downtown Nashville. This suite is located 2 minutes from music row surrounded by major attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, Country Music Hall of Fame, Nissan Stadium, & more. The suite is perfect for families, couples, & business travelers with many bars, restaurants, and shopping in walking distance. Parking in secured Garage is $30/Day.

The space
The Royal Luxe Suite is designed to give you a high end & comfortable experience. The Unique barn door gives you privacy when closed & an open airy feeling when pushed open. The apartment has 2 queen beds, a convertible sofa, and a portable sleeping cot to allow for comfortable sleeping arrangements. Looking to kick back and stay in for a couple days, we've got you covered. Take advantage of some streaming with our Roku smart TV which includes access (using your log in) to Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Youtube, Wifi, and more. The kitchen is stocked with cookware if you desire to dine in. In need of some fun? We have a swimming pool with beautiful outdoor sitting and grilling areas available. For those who need to get fit, visit our 24 hour fitness center including a rock climbing wall and yoga studio. Visit our 2 level lounge 24 hours a day for some quiet study time, work, or relaxation. There is a washer and dryer in the unit for your laundry needs. Lastly, the suite is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized immediately after check-out by our cleaners. 
Permit #2018071744

Guest access
Entire space

Other things to note
There is also a pull out single person Cot located in the closet if needed.
